content:
**Cryologist**, formerly **Science Master**, is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Increases Cryo damage based on current Intelligence.

| ![FO76 cryologist perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/f/fd/FO76_cryologist_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Intelligence | Cryo Damage | 
| | 1 | +5% | 
| | 15 | +22% | 
| | 30 | +35% | 
| | 60 | +45% | 
| | 100 | +50% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Increase cryo damage based on your INT. | 003440C2 | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Science Master." It used to have 2 ranks that provided +5%/+10% damage to non-heavy energy weapons. Rank 1 of this perk was required for crafting rank 3 energy weapons mods and crafting energy weapons with rank 2 of this perk gave them more durability. With this rework the perk is no longer needed to craft any mods and the durability bonus is no longer present.
